title: Population 1 January and population changes during the calendar year (M) 1951 - 2026
notes: Population 1 January is a stock; births, deaths, immigration, emigration and population increase are annual flows.
SSB notes that population figures for 1951, 1956, 1961, 1962 and 1966-1970 do not match population figures in some other tables.
For the contribution view, deaths and emigration are plotted with a negative sign to place outflows on the opposite side of zero. The source values themselves are non-negative counts.
For the heatmap, colour and the small in-cell bar encode a within-series percentile. This is a visual transformation for pattern detection; exact counts remain available in the selected-cell readout.
Population increase may differ slightly from excess of births plus net migration because statistical adjustments can occur. Table 06913 does not expose the adjustment as a separate content variable.
